title: Mumbai’s pollution can be halved in five years, but target must be MMR

Since 2011, vehicle registrations have nearly tripled, while pollution sources include dust, industries, and waste burning. A comprehensive regional clean air plan is essential to address these issues effectively across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. Efforts must include improved monitoring, cleaner energy sources for industries, and sustainable transport solutions.

title: 28,800 rubber ducks lost at sea in 1992 still tracked today
content: A cargo ship accident in January 1992 released a multitude of plastic toys into the ocean's depths. Oceanographers seized this unexpected incident as a unique opportunity to study ocean currents and their migration patterns. Through collaboration with beachcombers and intricate simulations, they gathered crucial data, unveiling new insights on global ocean connectivity. Despite the degradation of most toys over time, their remarkable journey still aids scientists in examining marine debris.

title: Toddlers who give then take back toys are learning to share, psychology says

To nurture these skills, parents should encourage enjoyable social activities without forcing them to share.

title: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary’s appeal to give up free electricity triggers row
content: Tejashwi Yadav has been continuously criticising the Samrat Choudhary-led National Democratic Alliance (NDA) government, claiming it to be “on the verge of bankruptcy”

title: Marital discord no ground for termination of pregnancy: SC
content: a bench of justices said termination of pregnancy can be allowed in case of rape and sexual assault or if there is some problem with the foetus . it questioned where society would be headed if a woman could decide to abort on the ground that she was ill-treated or abused by her husband and in-laws .

title: Indian national killed as helicopters collide near Mount Everest; video captures crash
content: two helicopters collided while attempting to land near Mount Everest in Nepal . an Indian national was killed and three others were injured in a helicopter crash . a video of the incident has captured the moment the two aircraft collides .

title: Florida jet 'broke apart' midair before crashing; 20-year-old pilot among victims
content: the aircraft was flying from Austin, Texas, to the Bahamas on Sunday . it suddenly went into a steep nosedive, leaving behind a crater and a widespread debris field near west Palm Beach . investigators are examining whether severe weather, ice accumulation and turbulence contributed to the crash .

title: 'Rs 14,000cr loss last month': Delhi traders seek protest-free Delhi till Nov 11
content: trade body cited significant business losses caused by demonstrations over past month . request comes amid concerns over disruptions to commercial activity during festive season . traders' body urged police not to grant permission for such events . ci says repeated disruptions have affected markets and restricted customer movement .

title: 'Lousy con artist': BJP attacks Rahul after his 'foreign help' jibe at PM Modi
content: BJP spokesperson questioned Rahul's foreign visits . he alleged that the Congress leader had sought foreign interference in India's internal affairs . Kesavan called Rahul a "lousy con artist" and accused him of misleading claims that backfire .

title: AIFF bid to break Rs 20 crore FD to pay Brazil, Uruguay for friendlies stalled
content: all India football Federation's proposal to break fixed deposit of Rs 20 crore was stalled by general body members . five-time world champions brazil and former world cup winners Uruguay were invited for two high-profile international friendlies against india in Kolkata last month . sources said Brazil and Uruguay have received only 50% of their appearance fees .

title: 'I've got turbulence': Co-pilot's final text to boyfriend mins before Florida jet crash
content: a 20-year-old co-pilot texted her pilot boyfriend just minutes before the crash . her stepfather recalls the message she sent to her boyfriend . the plane plunged to the ground in Palm Beach County on sunday afternoon .

title: Maldives' former foreign minister Abdulla Shahid arrested in child abuse case
content: former foreign affairs minister was arrested on suspicion of sexually abusing a minor . the 64-year-old was emerging as a potential presidential challenger to incumbent Mohamed Muizzu in the 2028 elections . he has rejected the allegations, calling them baseless and politically motivated .

title: US launches 'secret' strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island as peace talks teeter along
content: peace talks teeter along The united states launched 'secret' strikes on Iran's Qeshm island . the attacks were part of a series of limited military operations carried out by Washington in recent weeks, the WSJ said . israel reportedly pressed president Donald Trump to consider fresh military action against Iran .
